name: Tatami Grid
description: Lays its children out as tatami mats, half or full, arranged so that four corners never meet, and re-lays the room with a layout animation when mats are added, removed or resized.

props.name: columns
props.description: Half-mat cells across the room. A full mat covers two cells, lying across or along. The room drops to fewer cells when they would be narrower than 104px.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between mats and around the room, in pixels.

props.name: children
props.description: TatamiMat elements, each with a key. They are placed in reading order as far as the rule allows; when the mats cannot fill the room exactly, the rest is laid as plain floor boards.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the room, a muted well with rounded corners. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: span
props.description: A half mat is one square cell; a full mat is two cells, 2:1. Which way a full mat lies is chosen by the layout.

props.name: children
props.description: The mat's content. Each mat is a group named tatami with data-shape set to wide, tall or square, so content can adapt with group-data-[shape=tall]/tatami: and the like.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the content box inside the mat's cloth edging. Other div props are passed through.
